scope: Ten active skill concepts and thirteen icon concepts. No production or gameplay changes.
productionGate: Explicit approval separately per active-skill concept and per icon; partial approval never approves remaining entries.

provenance.authorship: Original AI-assisted raster concept art. No third-party sprite pack imported; no human hand-pixelled or exclusive copyright claim.
provenance.referenceLicense: Director references are direction-only; third-party rights not independently established. No reference pixels sampled into new art.
provenance.conceptIconCrops: Ten icons extracted from newly generated skill boards; standalone normal/passive icons generated separately. These crops are not production sprites or animation frames.

baseline.productionPolicy: New skill poses outside character lock; maintain fixed body scale/feet, separate character and VFX.

mechanicDependencies: CONTENT_DATA describes proposed effects. Concepts illustrate user-requested identities without finalizing rank values, costs, cooldowns or numbers.
Thái Cực Thần Công toggle/timed duration unresolved. Reusable activation/state/absorption/end concept is lifetime-neutral.
Exact slash/wave/pulse counts, area dimensions, field placement, duration and cadence depend on future authoritative skill data.
Counter trigger eligibility/window/recovery depends on authoritative events; no block, invulnerability, dash or forced evasion is implied.
Basic sword Kiếm Khí proc chance/timing/range is unimplemented/provisional; no extra VFX or guarantee approved by the icon.
Innate passive has icon only; no in-world effect approved.
referenceDiscrepancies: vo_dang_art_direction_reference.png absent; inspected vo_dang_character_reference.png and approved hero concept/atlases instead.
current_codex_dashboard_anti_reference.png contains Võ Đang direction artwork; wuxia_town_world_reference.png contains the dashboard negative. Follow actual contents.
thien_son_thieu_lam_character_reference.png depicts a town overworld. in_game_world_reference.png exists despite older README absence note.
illustrationGuardrails: Large key poses and small gameplay illustrations are conceptual drawings, not Phaser screenshots or logical-scale verification.
Side-view wording on projectile study labels describes the isolated VFX profile, not permission to change the elevated world camera.
Nhân Kiếm lower footprint row lays out successive poses horizontally; caster stays fixed, no dash or root movement.
Thất Tinh stars and Bát Quái edge swords are visual motifs, not authoritative hit counts.
Thái Cực Trận boundary-adjacent targets in inset illustrate feedback only; statuses must be clipped to authoritative inside-zone eligibility.
Thái Cực Trận v01 is superseded by v02: remove incidental sword props and vertical streaks. Both are retained unapproved.
All generated icon frames share silver corners/dark backing; exact border thickness and detail simplification require a shared production template after approval.

records.design: Quick inexpensive precise palm strike reducing enemy Attack Power. One narrow forward open-palm action, other hand retracts at waist. Compact paired dark/light palm contact mark; weakening feedback is a small broken downward chevron next to contacted target, no stun chains, shield, ranged orb, slow ring or defense-break symbol. Tiny neutral target silhouette only for feedback. Icon: open palm with split light/dark pressure mark and small descending notch; recognizable palm silhouette.

records.name: Thái Cực Trận
records.design: ULTIMATE: Yin-Yang ground field periodically damages and slows within its area. Palms gather -> press down/outward -> hold balanced stance -> return. Separate activation / sustained loop / periodic pulse / ending ground studies. Circular elevated-overworld ellipse with twin interlocking light-dark flowing boundary strokes, small yin-yang center seal and sparse inward curved accents; at least 80% open interior with visible stone ground, hero and targets. Pulse remains inside boundary, slow brackets only for targets inside. No sword symbols, imprisonment wall, ally protection, implosion, pulling, terrain cracks or opaque full-field disk. Area placement and size diagrammatic pending authoritative zone; no chosen exact radius/duration/pulse count. Icon: twin flowing ground-ring halves and small central yin-yang, distinct from personal shield and octagonal sword formation.

records.name: Tọa Sát Bác Đồ
records.design: SHORT COUNTER STANCE: being attacked prompts retaliatory slash. Four panels MUST be separately labelled READY / ATTACK RECEIVED / TRIGGERED RESPONSE / RECOVERY. Readiness: bent knees, straight sword held diagonally close to torso, tiny incomplete light-dark crescent near hilt; no shield bubble. Attack-received panel permits small contact mark on hero, no blocked-X or zero damage. Triggered response is ONE compact opposite diagonal close-range retaliatory slash. Show separate readiness loop + triggered counter + recovery + untriggered ending neutral stance. No invulnerability, guaranteed block, damage reflection beam, evade/dash/teleport or healing. Icon: low angled guard blade plus small hooked returning slash, no shield.
